name: local-agent-bridge
description: CortexIDE coding agent on local models (vLLM / Ollama), Claude (Anthropic API) or the Claude Code engine, with file, search and shell tools, SKILL.md skills, .canvas.tsx canvases, and chat import (including Cursor exports).

chatParticipants.name: local-agent
chatParticipants.description: Coding agent that reads SKILL.md files and canvases

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import a chat export (.md, e.g. from Cursor) and continue as an agent

disambiguation.description: The user wants an agent that follows SKILL.md skills, writes canvases, or does multi-step coding work with tools.
examples: Follow the canvas skill and write a dashboard
Act as a coding agent and edit the codebase

languageModelTools.name: list_skills
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List SKILL.md skills with name, description, and path.

languageModelTools.name: read_skill
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the full SKILL.md body for a skill by name. Call before following a skill.

languageModelTools.name: match_skills
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find skills matching a task query.

languageModelTools.name: read_canvas
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a .canvas.tsx canvas by name or path.

languageModelTools.name: import_cursor_chat
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Import a Cursor chat export (.md) or agent transcript (.jsonl) into .cortexide/imported-chats and return an Agent-mode continuation prompt.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Import a Cursor chat and continue as an agent

path.description: Absolute path to a Cursor export .md or .jsonl

localAgentBridge.syncOnStartup.description: Sync SKILL.md skills into .cortexide/skills and rewrite agent/canvas rules when CortexIDE starts.

localAgentBridge.includeBuiltInSkills.description: Include ~/.cursor/skills-cursor (Cursor built-in skills such as canvas).

localAgentBridge.extraSkillRoots.description: Extra directories to scan for SKILL.md files.

localAgentBridge.maxSkills.description: CortexIDE only loads 64 slash-command skills. Extra catalog entries stay in the rule file and MCP tools.

enumDescriptions: vLLM / SGLang router if running, otherwise Ollama, otherwise Claude when credentials are set
vLLM or the Qud Lab SGLang router (:30000, then :8000)
Ollama (:11434), using its native API so num_ctx is honoured
Claude through the Anthropic Messages API (api.anthropic.com). Key from “Agent: Set Claude API Key”, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN or `ant auth login`.
The installed Claude Code CLI runs the agent — the same engine as the Claude app, with its own tools, skills, CLAUDE.md, MCP servers and subagents.
Any OpenAI-compatible URL set in localAgentBridge.agent.baseUrl
localAgentBridge.agent.provider.description: Model backend for the Agent panel.

localAgentBridge.agent.baseUrl.description: Override the backend URL (ending in /v1; for Claude, an API gateway in front of api.anthropic.com). Empty = provider defaults.

localAgentBridge.agent.model.description: Model id. Empty = first preferred model the backend serves.

localAgentBridge.agent.apiKey.description: Bearer key for the backend. Empty = %LOCALAPPDATA%QudLabllm-proxy-key.txt for vLLM. For Claude prefer “Agent: Set Claude API Key”, which uses Secret Storage.

localAgentBridge.agent.contextTokens.description: Context window to plan for. 0 = read max_model_len from the backend (Ollama: min(model limit, ollamaNumCtx); Claude: min(model window, 200k)).

localAgentBridge.agent.ollamaNumCtx.description: num_ctx sent to Ollama. Higher = more VRAM.

localAgentBridge.agent.maxOutputTokens.description: Max tokens per model reply on local backends (Claude uses claudeMaxOutputTokens). Thinking models (qwen3, deepseek-r1) need more, e.g. 4096-8192.

localAgentBridge.agent.claudeMaxOutputTo.description: Max tokens per Claude reply, thinking included. Replaces maxOutputTokens on the Claude backend.

enumDescriptions: The model's own default (medium on Claude Opus 5.5, high on most others)
Fewest thinking tokens; cheapest and fastest
Best for hard coding and long agentic tasks
localAgentBridge.agent.claudeEffort.description: Claude reasoning effort (output_config.effort). Only sent to models with adaptive thinking (Claude 4.6 and later).

localAgentBridge.agent.claudeWorkspaceId.description: Anthropic workspace id (wrkspc_…) sent as anthropic-workspace-id. Needed with a user-scoped key (sk-ant-usr-…); workspace-scoped keys leave it empty. Empty = ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID from the environment.

localAgentBridge.agent.claudeCodePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI for the claude-code backend. Empty = claude on PATH, then %USERPROFILE%\.local\bin\claude.exe.

enumDescriptions: File edits are applied without asking; shell commands follow localAgentBridge.agent.shell
Claude Code's auto mode: a classifier decides what may run
Anything that would need approval is denied (the panel cannot show Claude Code's prompts)
localAgentBridge.agent.claudeCodePermiss.description: Permission mode for the claude-code backend. The panel runs Claude Code headless, so a call that would prompt is denied and reported.

enumDescriptions: Use the bridge's Anthropic key when one is set, otherwise Claude Code's own login
Always the bridge's Anthropic key (Secret Storage, apiKey setting or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), with claudeWorkspaceId
Always Claude Code's own login (run claude and /login once); API keys in the environment are not passed on

localAgentBridge.agent.maxRounds.description: Max model↔tool rounds per request before the agent is asked to wrap up.

localAgentBridge.agent.shell.description: Shell tool: run without asking, ask for each command, or disabled. Obviously destructive commands are always blocked.

localAgentBridge.agent.writableRoots.description: Folders outside the open workspace that the agent may edit and run commands in (e.g. a game's Mods folder).

localAgentBridge.agent.readAnywhere.description: Let the agent read files outside the workspace (writes stay limited to workspace + writableRoots).

localAgentBridge.agent.requireReadBefore.description: Refuse whole-file Write over a file the agent has not Read, loose (indentation-tolerant) edits to unread files, and any edit to a file that changed on disk since the agent read it. Exact StrReplace matches are always allowed.

localAgentBridge.agent.diagnosticsAfterE.description: After each edit, wait briefly for the language server and add that file's errors to the edit result.

localAgentBridge.agent.subagents.description: Offer the Task tool: a read-only research sub-agent with its own context (uses extra model calls).
